A note, left where you’d find it

Welcome to my home, fellow creature. You are here and I may be mid–thought, so I pinned this where you’d see it. A few things about the room, that nothing may surprise you:

The fire eats unproven things. Every practice question you meet and cannot yet answer, you mark with an ✗ — and the fire remembers it. Let them pile up and it climbs higher and burns stranger. Prove them — turn your marks true — and watch it shrink. Click the fire whenever you like — it opens, and shows you exactly what it is chewing on, so you may go and prove it. It is not punishment. It is honesty, kept warm.

The little plant does not drink water. It drinks your visits. Come to the map each day and it grows — out of its pot, up the walls, across the whole room. Stay away and it wilts, grey and patient, holding your best run and waiting. It never dies. It is the quiet record of your showing up.

The shield is where I hang what you finish — every journey walked to its end, every region you come to know. It starts bare. It does not stay bare, if you keep walking.

The buttons above are how you ask me things: where to go next, what your map says of you, a story if the evening is long. Ask freely. I have little else to do but answer, and I have been alone with these stones a long time.

That is the room. Sit as long as you like — the fire knows you now.

— Gami

Note
How practice works

Paper first. Solve each question with a pencil before touching a button. Hint is a small nudge; Answer shows the full working once you have committed to yours.

Mark yourself honestly. Tap ✓ if you solved it, ✗ if not this time. Nothing is graded — the honesty is the whole point.

The dots ●●○ show difficulty: one filled is a warm-up, three is a proper challenge.

Three tiers. Warm-ups ease you in, Core covers every part of the lesson, and Stretch unlocks once you have proven most of the Core — deeper problems that combine ideas.

Every ✗ feeds the fire. In Gami’s home a fire burns for each question you mark wrong. Click that fire — it opens your whole “still to prove” list, lets you jump straight to any question or re-read the section it came from. Turn a ✗ into a ✓ and the fire shrinks.

Prove them all — every question ✓ — and the topic becomes Learned, ringed green on the map.
